questions.q: Which Dataverse trigger does Castlebridge Logistics use for the large majority of its flows?
options: When an action is performed
When a row is added, modified, or deleted
When a row is selected
When a flow is manually started
questions.explain: The lesson identifies 'When a row is added, modified, or deleted' as the trigger used for the large majority of real automation, since it fires automatically on data changes.

questions.q: What does the 'When a row is selected' trigger respond to?
options: A scheduled time of day
A row being deleted from a table
Someone clicking the Flow button on a row inside a model-driven app
A SQL Server stored procedure finishing
questions.explain: 'When a row is selected' is an on-demand trigger: it fires when a person clicks the Flow button on a specific row inside a model-driven app.

questions.q: What does the List rows action do?
options: Permanently deletes every row in a table
Retrieves rows from a table, with optional filtering
Creates a brand-new Dataverse table
Sends an email listing recent changes
questions.explain: List rows retrieves records from a table, and supports an optional filter so the flow isn't pulling every row on every run.

questions.q: Why would you add an OData filter expression to a List rows action, as in the Castlebridge example?
options: It's required before the action will save at all
To limit processing to only the rows that actually matter, instead of scanning the whole table
To rename the columns being returned
To convert the table into a SQL Server table
questions.explain: The filter expression in the lesson keeps only active shipments on one route, so the flow processes a targeted set of rows rather than the entire Shipments table every run.

questions.q: Why does the lesson suggest putting Delete a row behind an approval step?
options: Delete a row requires a premium license that approval steps unlock
Dataverse automatically reverses deletions after 24 hours anyway
Deletion in Dataverse can't be undone from inside the flow, so it carries real risk
Approval steps are required by Power Automate for every action
questions.explain: Because deleting a row is permanent and can't be undone from inside the flow, the lesson recommends gating it behind an approval step rather than letting it run unsupervised.
